entries.text: Allah's Name to commence with, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
When the earth is shaken violently with its destined tremor.
And (when) the earth casts out (all of) its burdens.
And mankind says, 'What has happened to it?'
On that Day, the earth will narrate (all) its news.
Because your Lord sent a command to it.
On that Day, people will return towards their Lord, in different paths, in order to be shown their deeds.
So, whosoever does a good deed equal to the weight of an atom, (he) shall see it.
And whoever does an evil deed equal to the weight of an atom, (he) shall see it.
